{"reason":"Add the existing high-confidence? condition. V1 produces 20 false arbitrations/28 (rate 0.714) despite recall 1.0. The added ≥0.7 gate rejects six shown false rows (confidence 0.44–0.67), reducing false arbitration while preserving magnitude, exposure, and frozen-horizon safeguards and targeting recall ≥0.8.","source":"(define (should-arbitrate? edi-change inventory-exposure)
  (and (> (abs (change-pct edi-change)) 0.15)
       (> inventory-exposure 500000)
       (not (frozen-horizon? edi-change))
       (high-confidence? edi-change)))"}
